message.content:
This machine fills trays with soil substrate and paper liners. Candidate headings are 8433 (agricultural harvesting machinery), 8436 (other agricultural/horticultural machinery), and 8422 (filling machinery). Heading 8436.80 covers other agricultural, horticultural, or forestry machinery, and I believe CBP has classified Ellepot machines there, though I am working from memory and have not checked a ruling.

Heading 8422.30 covers machinery for filling, closing, or packaging containers. Here the cells are filled with soil to produce paper pots for plant growing, which is a horticultural purpose. Heading 8436 has a subheading 8436.80 for "other machinery", with 8436.80.01 (stat suffix 0100 or similar) for the other machinery. I recall the 8436.80 breakdown as 8436.80.00 with 8436.80.0010 for poultry-keeping machinery and 8436.80.0090 for other. The HTSUS lists 8436.80.00 with statistical suffixes 10 (Poultry...?) and 90, so I am settling on 8436.80.0090.
